description: This folder contains a static mirror of satellitemap.space frontend assets. The live backend is replaced by server.mjs /local-api responses so the browser does not call external API hosts.
limitations: Live satellite positions, TLE updates, login/session persistence, ADS-B aircraft data, and server-side search are not bundled.
Static Astro pages and downloaded images/scripts are available locally.
Dynamic visualizer data endpoints return empty successful JSON responses unless you add real local datasets.
